mapper.select: SELECT p.id FROM picture p LEFT JOIN picture_stats s ON s.pictureId = p.id WHERE p.reviewStatus = 1 AND p.spaceId IS NULL AND p.isDelete = 0 ORDER BY (COALESCE(s.viewCount, 0) + COALESCE(s.likeCount, 0) + COALESCE(s.collectCount, 0) + COALESCE(s.downloadCount, 0) + COALESCE(s.shareCount, 0)) DESC, p.id ASC LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT p.id FROM picture p WHERE p.reviewStatus = 1 AND p.spaceId IS NULL AND p.isDelete = 0 ORDER BY p.createTime DESC, p.id DESC LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT p.id FROM picture p WHERE p.reviewStatus = 1 AND p.spaceId IS NULL AND p.isDelete = 0 ORDER BY MD5(CONCAT(#{seed}, ':', p.id)) ASC LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM picture p WHERE p.reviewStatus = 1 AND p.spaceId IS NULL AND p.isDelete = 0
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM picture p WHERE p.reviewStatus = 1 AND p.spaceId IS NULL AND p.isDelete = 0 AND p.picWidth IS NOT NULL AND p.picHeight IS NOT NULL AND p.picWidth * p.picHeight > #{minPixels}
